items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Jackson and Galvez, might be. I can't. [INTERVIEWEE] Did any band have a female vocalist around here? ...

ctx.x: At least, uh, I don't remember, no. Did you ever hear her sing? No. You didn't even know what she sang? No.

But they had some tough guys around Jackson Avenue, too. I can't remember those brothers' names. But they were back around Jackson and, uh. White, wasn't it? I don't know. Jackson and Gravia, or, I mean, Jackson and Galvez, might be. I can't.

Did any band have a female vocalist around here? Um, now, uh, we had a band, let's see, uh, Sales was in that band, too. I can't think of the name. I used to have a picture. I was looking for it last week. It got, I got misplaced there. Uh, it was an organized band, too. And, uh, we had a girl play piano. She used to sing. She was a vocalist and she played piano on us there. And they had, uh, let me see what they had played, uh, played bass tuba with us. Uh, what's he, he plays string bass now. August Langwell.…
